notes:
Summary: DoveGate is evaluating a private VPC deployment for inference supporting document search and reranking across EU operations. Primary concerns are data residency (EU-only), customer-managed KMS integration (AWS KMS with HSM-backed keys), and full audit log streaming into their SIEM (CloudTrail -> S3 -> Splunk). Security team explicitly asked for our SIG/CAIQ mapping and a clear shared-responsibility matrix. They want attestation for SOC2 + ISO27001 scope and a list of subprocessors.

Security questionnaire specifics / intake asks (paraphrased from call):
- Network: required architecture diagram showing subnets, NAT/Egress, peering, and any internet-facing endpoints.
- Authentication: SSO (SAML) + enforcement of SCIM provisioning or they will use manual provisioning for pilot.
- Keys: Must support CMKs via AWS KMS; key rotation policy; optional HSM-backed YubiHSM or CloudHSM support for later phase.
- Audit: Audit log retention policy min 1 year; ability to stream audit records to customer-owned S3; timestamps must be in UTC; logs must include request metadata and token/route identifiers for expense reconciliation.
- Data residency: all inference logs, embeddings, and KV cache must be stored and processed in eu-west-1 for production; POC can be in a temporary eu-based dev account.
- Compliance artifacts: need SOC2 report, ISO27001 cert, penetration test summary, vulnerability scanning cadence.
- Vendor risk: complete their internal vendor intake spreadsheet + attach SIG questionnaire PDF filled by Redwood.

Operational constraints and preferences:
- Latency targets: 95th p50 token latency < 200ms for short prompts (<=512 tokens) for reranking; throughput for embedding batches ~200 reqs/sec.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to accept higher infra for compliance but want Optimize recommendations to reduce token unit costs post-POC.
- Fallbacks: want routing policy to fallback to a lower-cost model in same region if primary capacity exhausted; need automated canary + rollback for model rollouts.

Quote from DoveGate security lead: "We need an auditable chain — who holds the keys, where the logs live, and an airtight vendor intake before procurement."
